caption: The image is a monochromatic drawing, primarily in shades of black and white, printed on a square textile with a decorative floral border. In the center, there is a scene featuring a group of men gathered at the base of a rocky hill. On top of the hill, there is a structure resembling a classical building with columns and a domed roof, with rays emanating from behind it. The hill has the words "CONSTITUTION & LAWS" inscribed on it, partially covered by a flowing American flag. The men at the base are dressed in various period clothing, including military uniforms and civilian attire. They are shown in dynamic poses, many with one arm raised, holding objects such as hats, swords, and axes, and looking toward the structure atop the hill. The entire central scene is framed by the aforementioned intricate floral border. The textile appears to be laid flat on a neutral surface.
title: Printed Textile - Historical
